alt: 孩子與老師欣賞一隻形態逼真的陶鳥作品，窗外另有一隻真鳥停在枝頭。
scene_prompt: Meaning: 栩栩如生 means something looks so lifelike and vivid it seems alive. Show an elementary student standing beside a remarkably lifelike clay bird sculpture on a low secure display plinth: the crafted bird's feather texture, alert eye and poised wing look realistic but it is clearly sculpted from matte clay with subtle tool marks at the base. A parent and art teacher admire it, and a small real bird is visible outside the studio window for contrast. The sculpture remains stationary and clearly a sculpture; no magical motion. Natural human anatomy, hands not touching fragile sculpture, stable plinth, realistic bird anatomy. No readable text.
style_prompt: Create ONE original children's picture-book illustration for a Traditional Chinese idiom learning website. Landscape 3:2. NO readable text, letters, numerals, captions, logos, watermarks or recognizable existing characters. Contemporary community art studio. Delicate graphite pencil contours, soft watercolor and colored-pencil grain on warm ivory textured paper, restrained natural colors, no glossy 3D.
